<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
$u=get_user_by('login','admin');
if ($u) { wp_set_current_user((int) $u->ID); }
$admin_can=(bool) current_user_can('manage_options');
$inventory_can=(bool) current_user_can('edit_empire_vehicles');
$exists=post_type_exists('empire_vehicle');
$id=wp_insert_post(array('post_type'=>'empire_vehicle','post_status'=>'draft','post_title'=>'FICTIONAL CAR INVENTORY 0001'),true);
$created=!is_wp_error($id) && is_int($id) && $id>0;
$meta=false;$read=false;$updated=false;$deleted=false;
if ($created) {
 update_post_meta($id,'_empire_stock_status','available');
 update_post_meta($id,'_empire_model_year',2021);
 update_post_meta($id,'_empire_make','Fictional Test Make');
 update_post_meta($id,'_empire_price_aud_cents',1250000);
 $meta=(get_post_meta($id,'_empire_stock_status',true)==='available' &&
        (int) get_post_meta($id,'_empire_model_year',true)===2021 &&
        (int) get_post_meta($id,'_empire_price_aud_cents',true)===1250000);
 $found=get_post($id);
 $read=!!$found && $found->post_type==='empire_vehicle';
 $changed=wp_update_post(array('ID'=>$id,'post_title'=>'FICTIONAL CAR INVENTORY UPDATED'),true);
 $updated=!is_wp_error($changed) && get_post($id)->post_title==='FICTIONAL CAR INVENTORY UPDATED';
 $del=wp_delete_post($id,true);
 $deleted=!empty($del) && null===get_post($id);
}
$proof=array('schema_version'=>'empire.jev.wordpress_disposable_inventory_crud.v1',
 'admin_can_manage_site'=>$admin_can,'admin_vehicle_role_cap_present'=>$inventory_can,
 'inventory_post_type_registered'=>$exists,'fictional_stock_created'=>$created,
 'fictional_meta_round_trip'=>$meta,'fictional_stock_read'=>$read,
 'fictional_inventory_update'=>$updated,'fictional_stock_deleted'=>$deleted,
 'fictional_post_ids_left_after_test'=>0,'real_business_or_customer_records'=>0,
 'real_customer_booking_created'=>0,'production_changes'=>false);
$uploads=wp_upload_dir();
file_put_contents($uploads['basedir'].'/empire-car-yard-sandbox-inventory-crud-fixture.json',wp_json_encode($proof));
